payload.recallText:
"Well would you look at that" Joe Martsen said. "What is it, Joe" his sister Clara asked. 
"It's a letter, sis." 
"What's it say, Joe?" she said looking at her brothers handsome face.
She loves the sport as much as her brother does. 
He was swinging his hand around as Mrs. Martsen opened the door and he hit the pitcher she was carrying and it broke and got water all over.
"Sorry Momsey"
"What were you thinking, oh no now my rug is ruined"
Joe explained they wanted to draft him but it wasn't decided yet.
His sister Clara said "of course they would want you, you're the best pitcher."
